items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: I stayed with the group because I did a recording date with Claude Hopkins. He did my tune, for one thing, 'Yacht Club Swing.' ... I had Claude Hopkins. Claude Hopkins would go on piano.

ctx.x: No. No, no. I didn't work in that band with Ed. Ed had left before I ever joined him. And I joined -- I joined them -- that was quite a while after he left. I stayed with the group because I did a recording date with Claude Hopkins. He did my tune, for one thing, 'Yacht Club Swing.'
